review_comment: The middleware reads memcache server configuration from an external memcache.conf file when main configuration is empty. This external file controls network socket connections without validation of hostnames or IP addresses. If the file is writable by untrusted users, it could redirect cache traffic to arbitrary destinations. Validate memcache server addresses against an allowlist or implement file integrity checks before using configuration from external files.

The code retrieves memcache server configuration without validating the format or authorization of specified servers. This could allow connection to unauthorized memcache instances if untrusted configuration is provided. Add format validation for host:port syntax and implement an allowlist of approved memcache servers before establishing connections.

line_snippet: [s.strip() for s in self.memcache_servers.split(',') if s.strip()])
